save.title: Save Game
save.hint: The game saves itself — return to your match with the Continue button in the menu. Here you can additionally copy the save as text (Show save, then Ctrl+C) or paste a previously copied save (Ctrl+V) and click Load.
save.selected: Save selected — press Ctrl+C to copy.
save.empty: No save to show — play a match first.
save.incompatible: This save comes from an incompatible game version.
save.corrupt: This does not look like a valid game save.

tooltip.pickEmpireHint: 👉 Click to play as this empire
help.goal: Goal: capture the capitals of all enemies.
help.pickEmpire: At the start, you can click any capital to play as that empire (until you make your first move).
help.moves: You have 5 orders per turn. An ordered unit spends its own movement points and can keep going without another order.
help.clickArmy: Click your army, then a highlighted adjacent tile.
help.merge: Moving onto a tile with your own army merges them (max 99, same type only).
help.unitTypes: 3 unit types: infantry (balanced, 2 movement points), tanks (strong attack and 4 movement points, weaker defense) and artillery (strong defense and support, weak attack, 2 movement points).
help.buildChoice: Click your own city to choose which unit type it builds.
help.production: Cities produce +1 strength per turn, the capital +3.
help.resources: Resources (oil well, farmland, mine) give +1 production once you build a road to them from a city's production panel (costs production points instead of units, only through your own territory). Roads only speed up an army that travels along them: entering your own road costs 1 movement point instead of 2.
help.morale: Morale drops with distance from your nearest city and at sea — it affects combat strength.
help.support: Adjacent friendly armies give support in battle; a city strengthens the defender.
help.ports: From a port (⚓), an army can sail out to sea and land on any shore. Embarking and landing use up all movement points, and at sea every unit sails 3 tiles.
help.annex: Capturing an enemy capital annexes their entire empire.
help.teams: In multiplayer, slots can form teams: allies never fight each other or take each other's tiles, and victory counts for the whole team.
